title: Swap Your Shell Crab Brawl
competitors: Shells (cozy shell-collecting w/ hermit crab companion, not PvP) – 3.48M visits – Rolimons/ProGameGuides Aug 2026; Crab Tycoon – no numbers seen; no hermit-crab shell-theft brawler found
demand_check: unverified: Another Crab's Treasure (2024) is a niche indie; no trend data seen for crab/shell theme on Roblox beyond Shells' modest 3.48M
red_flags: 'doll head' shell is mildly creepy for kids; PvP needs players (bots feasible)
why: The PvP shell-theft niche is empty, but demand is unproven and a brawl alone monetizes weakly.
pivot: Make shells an RNG rarity collection with a base to protect/steal from, so theft feeds a steal-protect economy instead of a round brawl.

title: Tour the City Live
competitors: Be IRL Streamer, Streamer Life, Streamer Simulator, StreamSim, Streamer X, Be a Streamer! – visits not seen – roblox.com/games search Sep 2026; IShowSpeed has a Roblox place 'IShowSpeed' – numbers not seen
demand_check: verified: IShowSpeed's month-long US IRL tour drew massive crowds in SF/Oakland (CBS News, Yahoo 2025)
red_flags: Real-person likeness (IShowSpeed) must not be used; large city map + scaling crowd AI is a heavy build and a server-performance risk
why: Demand for the streamer-mob fantasy is real, but the streamer-sim lane is full and the city-plus-crowd-AI scope is too big for one month.
pivot: Drop the Speed likeness and city; do a single plaza arena where one player-streamer does stunts while everyone else is the chasing crowd (round-based, NPC fans as bot fallback).

title: Ding Dong Dash the Doorbell Cam
competitors: Ding Dong Ditch A Brainrot – 35.1M visits, 316 CCU – Rolimons Sep 2026; Ding Dong Ditch (90811512167676) – no numbers; Ding Dong Dash (doorbell-cam house finding) – no numbers; Knock Knock – no numbers
demand_check: unverified: evidence 'none'; the 35.1M-visit ditch game down to 316 CCU suggests a short spike, not ongoing demand
red_flags: Asym mode needs homeowner players (NPC fallback required); prank-on-neighbours framing is mild
why: Several ding-dong-ditch games already exist, the 35M leader has faded to ~300 CCU, and round-based asym play monetizes poorly.

title: Tow the Bad Parkers
competitors: Tow a Car (tow illegally parked cars to drop-off) – no numbers seen; Tow Truck Simulator (15163370289) – no numbers; Vehicle Simulator tow-truck gamepass (impound mechanic) – wiki; Towing Simulator – no numbers
demand_check: unverified: evidence 'none'; no numbers seen for towing games
red_flags: Asymmetric mode needs both sides filled; vehicle physics + tug-of-war hook is fiddly
why: Plain towing is already done several times, and the asym parker-vs-tower twist depends on player counts that small servers won't have.
pivot: Make it steal-and-protect: players tow rare cars from rival lots into their own impound base, and owners buy locks and wheel clamps.

title: Spot the Traitor Squad
competitors: Ball VS Ball (roll-to-fight) – 41.25M visits, 31.6K CCU – Rolimons Sep 2026 (brief's 14.7K is outdated/low); Units Battlegrounds (auto battler) – no numbers; Impostor | Among us – no numbers; no auto-battler+traitor hybrid found
demand_check: verified: Ball VS Ball 41.2M visits / 31.6K current players (Rolimons, Sep 2026); MM2 figures not re-checked
red_flags: Needs ~8 players to work, with no clear bot fallback; hard to tell a sabotaging player from bad RNG, so votes feel random
why: The hybrid is new, but deduction breaks when a weak unit might just be a bad roll, and party rounds monetize at ~18% of collection games.
pivot: Make the saboteur's actions visible but ambiguous (they secretly pick the reroll for a teammate's slot) and cap rounds at 4 players with bots.

title: Match a Pet Pair
competitors: Raise Puppies (breeding) – no numbers seen; Adopt and Raise – no numbers; Adopt Me! (trade, no stranger-breeding) – numbers not re-checked; no stranger-lounge co-breeding game found
demand_check: verified: Mewgenics sold 1M copies in one week, >$23M (Game Informer / PC Gamer, Feb 2026) - PC indie, not Roblox proof
red_flags: 'Speed-meet lounge' with 30s pairings looks like an online-dating flow (Roblox bans dating), even with pets only; forced stranger co-play needs a busy server
why: Stranger co-breeding is new and breeding monetizes well, but the speed-dating framing is a moderation risk and needs a busy server.
pivot: Swap the lounge for an async 'stud board': list your pet, others request a pairing from anywhere, and both owners get the baby - no timed 1:1 meetups.

title: Drive the Server Bus
competitors: a dusty trip – 1.2B+ visits, ~25K CCU regularly – Dexerto/earnaldo 2026; A Never Ending RV Trip, An Infinite Road Trip, Desert Bus, the TRUE bus experience (shared-vehicle road trips) – no numbers; Build the Pyramid! (100-player co-op) – exists, CCU not seen
demand_check: verified: A Dusty Trip 1.2B visits / ~25K CCU (Dexerto codes page 2026); Build the Pyramid 4.3K CCU claim not seen
red_flags: 100 players on one moving physics vehicle is a network/physics nightmare; one griefing driver ends the whole server's run; needs many players
why: A Dusty Trip owns road-trip survival at 1.2B visits, several shared-bus games exist, and a 100-player moving bus is not buildable reliably in a month.

title: Roll the Server Planet
competitors: Katamari (alpha) – no numbers, looks dead – roblox.com; Rolling Ball Simulator (grow-by-rolling) – no numbers – roblox.com; no server-merge katamari found
demand_check: unverified: Build the Pyramid! exists as a 100-player co-op server-goal game (roblox.com/wikis Sep 2026) but its 4.3K CCU / 1.1M visits were not seen; no Roblox katamari hit seen
red_flags: Sticking hundreds of parts to balls is a performance risk (fake it with scale plus decals); ball merging needs consent rules to prevent griefing
why: Katamari rolling is visually clickable and the lane has only dead micro-games, though demand on Roblox is unproven.

title: Breed a Snake
competitors: Snake Simulator, Be a Snake, Snake Game (slither-style grow, not breeding) – no numbers – roblox.com; no Roblox snake-morph breeding game found
demand_check: verified: MorphMarket lists 27,900+ ball pythons for sale (US & Canada) - real-hobby signal, not Roblox demand
red_flags: Snakes put some kids off; keep morphs colorful and stylized
why: No Roblox occupant for morph breeding, a real collector hobby behind it, and visible-trait gacha breeding is a proven high-monetization loop that is cheap to build.

title: Send the Tower Troops
competitors: Tower Wars (5962318698) – no numbers; Towers War (Doomspire copy, different mechanic); Conquest: Napoleonic Wars (RTS drag-select) – no numbers; no drag-to-send tower-capture game found
demand_check: unverified: Tower War - Tactical Conquest (SayGames) exists on iOS/Android, but the $3.5M / 9.5M install figures were not seen
red_flags: Alliances in chat mean text moderation reliance; 4-player live map needs bots for empty servers
why: Buildable and unoccupied on Roblox, but a skins-only round strategy game monetizes poorly and hypercasual demand may not carry over.
pivot: Add a collectible troop/commander roster (RNG rolls, upgrades) that you bring into matches, so there is progression to spend on.
